blocks.text: Reina Filipinas Angelica Lopez is in need of public votes to help her secure a spot in the “Top 10 pre-arrival” of the 2026 Miss Grand International pageant. As in the previous editions, the Miss Grand International pageant will again have 10 delegates at an elusive dinner with Nawat Itsaragrisil, the organization’s president, and the reigning queen. READ: Angelica Lopez from Palawan crowned Reina Filipinas Grand International Last year’s winner is broadcaster Emma Tiglao, the second Filipino woman to receive the pageant’s “Golden Crown.” She will be joining Nawat and the 10 chosen delegates for this year’s exclusive dinner.
